expectations.text: Names Linear or Height together with a specific borrowed mechanic (grouped lists with counts, keyboard navigation or command palette, inline editing, or optimistic updates) rather than only the product name
expectations.evidence: Three Linear mechanics named: grouped collapsible sections with per-group counts, restrained status-dot colour with priority glyph, and arrow-key/Enter row navigation scoped to the existing router.push.

expectations.text: Preserves the existing status filter and its three options (all, open, closed) in the redesign
expectations.evidence: Filter control preserved with exactly All / Open / Closed; invariant pins it to the same ?status= query param.

expectations.text: Flags that the component has no loading state and no empty state today, and specifies both in the generated prompt
expectations.evidence: States section records loading, empty and error as 'not handled' today, notes useSWR already exposes isLoading and error, and the prompt specifies all three.

expectations.text: Surfaces response data that is already returned but unrendered (priority, labels, updated_at, comment_count, or avatar_url) as usable without any new API
expectations.evidence: Lists priority, labels, updated_at, comment_count, assignee.avatar_url and id as fetched-but-unrendered — 'the cheapest lever in this redesign'.

expectations.text: States explicitly that the redesign is presentation-only and preserves row-click navigation to /issues/:id
expectations.evidence: Header states 'Presentation-only redesign'; invariant: 'Clicking (or keyboard-selecting) an issue row still calls router.push('/issues/:id')'.

expectations.text: Any proposed API addition is additive-only and states what the design renders before it ships (graceful degradation)
expectations.evidence: Single addition: optional `counts` field on the existing endpoint, 'existing consumers that only read issues are unaffected', degrades to group headers with no count.
